title: Source identity
subtitle: Preserve & identify
description: Record the original file's size, JPEG signature and SHA-256. The source remains unchanged.

parameters.label: Acquisition note
parameters.placeholder: Where did this file come from?

title: File structure
subtitle: Map the encoded file
description: Inventory original JPEG markers, frames, sampling, scan layout and restart intervals without decoding pixels. Damaged inputs retain partial records with warnings.

title: Metadata inventory
subtitle: Declarations & directories
description: Inventory metadata blocks and bounded classic TIFF/Exif declarations. GPS IFD values are excluded by default; metadata is not authenticated provenance.

title: Quantization atlas
subtitle: The encoder's frequency choices
description: Extract exact stored quantization tables, frame component assignments and scan-time table definitions without decoding pixels. Partial files retain complete definitions with warnings.

title: Entropy coding
subtitle: Codebooks & scan choices
description: Extract stored Huffman definitions, canonical codes and scan-time assignments. Symbol usage, compression efficiency and optimized-encoder identification are not measured.

title: Embedded images
subtitle: Thumbnails as separate evidence
description: Extract bounded Exif IFD1 and JFXX JPEG preview ranges, identities and optional nested structure records. No pixels are compared or decoded.

title: Byte distribution
subtitle: Measure the original byte stream
description: Compute exact counts for byte values 0–255 and descriptive Shannon entropy over the whole file. This is not a tampering score.

title: Encoder profiles
subtitle: Compatible sources, not certainty
description: Reserve a reference-profile comparison adapter. No source database is enrolled; no manufacturer or editor attribution is performed.

title: Stored DCT arrays
subtitle: Entropy decode, without IDCT
description: Read stored quantized DCT arrays using the optional jpeglib backend in a bounded worker. Supports 8-bit baseline/progressive grayscale or three-component JPEG; no pixel decode.

title: Coefficient statistics
subtitle: Frequency-wise distributions
description: Reserve coefficient histograms and dependencies. Requires an implemented stored-coefficient reader.

title: Compression history
subtitle: Test earlier-quantization hypotheses
description: Reserve a published-method adapter for aligned recompression. The method and its validated operating conditions remain to be selected.

title: Evidence report
subtitle: Observations with provenance
description: Assemble earlier Phase 1 results from this run with source identity, provenance, coverage and warnings. Select tools and this report together; separate runs are not merged.

title: Decoded reference
subtitle: One source, a fixed pixel reference
description: Configure a reproducible Python decode of the same JPEG loaded in Phase 1. Decoder, color, orientation and sampling choices must be recorded. The current image is a browser display preview; no Python reference pixels have been created.

title: Spatial measurements
subtitle: Histograms, texture & eligible regions
description: Plan intensity/channel histograms, local variation, gradients and valid-region masks from the fixed decoded reference. These measurements describe usable evidence; low texture or clipping is not proof of editing.

title: Current JPEG grid
subtitle: Locate the present block lattice
description: Reserve a local JPEG-grid method adapter for boundary responses, grid phase and spatial support. The visible coordinate guide is not a detected JPEG grid. A published method must be reviewed before any detector result is reported.

title: Displaced earlier grids
subtitle: Search for crop and translation traces
description: Configure a future search for an earlier JPEG lattice displaced from the current one. Candidate integer phases and support would be evaluated separately. A shifted grid alone does not establish a local content edit.

title: Calibration & recompression
subtitle: Explicitly derived comparison images
description: Reserve method-specific reconstructions, shifted crops and controlled recompressions. Every derived copy must retain its encoder and transform settings. A bright recompression residual is not an editing probability.

title: Regional compression
subtitle: Compare supported local measurements
description: Plan regional comparisons of compression traces with explicit window support. Texture and sample size can change the response without different processing histories. The regional method and valid sample requirements are not yet selected.

title: Main image vs previews
subtitle: Register embedded images before comparison
description: Plan comparison with separately extracted thumbnails or previews. Registration must account for crop, orientation, resolution and tone differences. A stale preview may have an ordinary export explanation. Extraction and registration are pending.

title: Scaled earlier grids
subtitle: Search for candidate non-eight-pixel periods
description: Configure a future search for scaled traces of an older JPEG lattice, including fractional spacing. Interpolation, scene repetition and the final grid can produce competing responses. No scale is currently estimated.

title: Rotated earlier grids
subtitle: Angle, spacing and phase candidates
description: Plan orientation-sensitive earlier-grid analysis, beginning with rotation alone. A joint geometry search and its false alarms require validation. Right-angle lossless transforms and interpolated rotations need different controls.

title: Threshold & directional study
subtitle: Published baseline and later comparisons
description: Reserve a comparison workspace for Robert Grou-Szabo's published dynamic-threshold work and applicable baselines. Method replication comes first. Future extensions remain proposals; no threshold or directional analysis is executed here.

title: Spatial JPEG report
subtitle: Evidence, coordinates and limitations
description: Configure the future spatial-evidence assembler, linking measurements to their regions and coordinate systems. The framework phase summary below already reports execution status; this Python analysis step is not connected.

title: Resampling
subtitle: Resize and rotation hypotheses
description: Configure a future search for resampling correlations. Integer cropping and right-angle transforms may lack interpolation traces; periodic patterns do not uniquely establish a resize or rotation.

title: Tonal mappings
subtitle: Gamma, contrast and curves
description: Plan histogram and regional tests for a defined mapping family. Native camera curves, noise, clipping and JPEG can produce similar effects; exact historical curve recovery is not promised.

title: Hue & channel relationships
subtitle: Color dependencies and clipping
description: Configure descriptive color relationships and a future method-specific test. Hue is unreliable near zero saturation; color conversion and camera-pipeline assumptions must be recorded.

title: White balance & illumination
subtitle: Regional chromaticity checks
description: Plan regional illumination comparisons. Mixed lighting and colored surfaces are confounders. A metadata-dependent method needs a supported white-point declaration; none is enrolled by this form.

title: Blur & local sharpness
subtitle: Conditional blur measurements
description: Configure sharpness views and a specified blur model. Optical defocus, motion, resampling and denoising can resemble each other. Insufficient edges should lead to abstention.

title: Filtering & denoising
subtitle: Defined operation families
description: Plan tests for one filter family. Median-filter evidence cannot be assumed to detect Gaussian, bilateral or learned denoising. Later compression and low texture require separate controls.

title: Sharpening
subtitle: Halos and edge profiles
description: Plan descriptive overshoot, ringing and edge-profile measurements. JPEG ringing, optics and interpolation are competing explanations. No sharpening classifier has been selected.

title: Noise consistency
subtitle: Signal-dependent regional behavior
description: Configure future noise-curve and regional comparisons. Texture is not noise; lighting, ISO, HDR, local tone mapping and denoising can change measured residuals.

title: CFA & demosaicing
subtitle: Interpolation consistency
description: Plan periodic inter-channel consistency tests where a compatible camera pipeline is plausible. Resizing, JPEG and non-Bayer or synthetic inputs can invalidate assumptions; missing traces do not establish synthetic origin.

title: Sensor / device references
subtitle: Requires independent enrollment
description: Record a plan for reference-dependent sensor comparison. A single unknown image cannot enroll its own trustworthy sensor fingerprint. No reference loading, fingerprint extraction or matching is implemented.

parameters.label: Reference manifest identifier (note only; not loaded)

title: Learned forensic traces
subtitle: Optional model-specific comparison
description: Describe a future model comparison. No model or weights are installed or selected by these controls. Model scores are not calibrated authenticity probabilities; terms, version and distribution shifts need review.

title: Copy-move candidates
subtitle: Geometrically consistent pairs
description: Plan correspondence tests between regions of the same image. Natural repetition is a negative control. Scale, rotation and compression robustness must be evaluated separately.

title: Compositing & physical consistency
subtitle: Explicit regional hypotheses
description: Configure a defined consistency question, not a sum of heatmaps. Geometry, lens correction and regional processing complicate interpretation; several tests require scene assumptions or references not supplied here.

title: Operation-order hypotheses
subtitle: Limited candidate histories
description: Record a finite comparison of processing sequences after individual methods are evaluated. Prerequisites remain unmet; this does not reconstruct arbitrary image history or execute earlier steps.

parameters.label: Proposed sequence pair
options: Resize → JPEG vs JPEG → resize → JPEG
Tone mapping before vs after final JPEG
parameters.default: Resize → JPEG vs JPEG → resize → JPEG
